Title: Personal Portfolio Website
Description: A personal portfolio website built to showcase my skills, projects, and resume.   Features include a clean UI, responsive design, social links, project gallery, resume download, and a real-time contact form that sends messages to my Telegram.

Title: PDFBAZI – Client-Side PDF Processing Web Application
Description: PDFBAZI – All-in-One PDF Management Tool  PDFBAZI is a client-side web application that provides multiple PDF tools such as merge, split, compress, convert, watermark, and password protection. All processing happens directly in the browser using JavaScript, ensuring data privacy without uploading files to any server. The project is deployed on Netlify and focuses on performance, security, and user-friendly UI.

Title: CampusClick – Campus Events, Hackathons & Photo Gallery Platform
Description: CampusClick is a student-focused web application designed to showcase campus events, hackathons, and student activities. The platform allows students to view, upload, and like event photos, creating a shared digital space for campus memories. Student can get information about hackathons and events uploaded by Admin (Faculty). Built using frontend web technologies and deployed on Netlify with a focus on usability and clean UI.
